subject: Approval: short security blurb for NovaPay case study
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@novapay.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Samir Patel <samir.p@novapay.com>
Date: 2026-04-12T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Approval: short security blurb for NovaPay case study

Hi Elena —

Thanks again for agreeing to the case study. Marketing has a short security/compliance blurb they want to include on the public page and in the PDF we’ll publish. Before we go live we need a short, customer-approved sentence referencing your attestation(s).

Suggested snippet (feel free to edit):
"NovaPay maintains SOC 2 Type II attestation and ISO 27001 certification for its payments platform, with controls covering availability and data integrity."

Would you mind confirming or sending a one-line alternative we can use? We can redact any detail you don’t want public. Attached is the draft PDF with the callout highlighted.

Attachment: marketing-case-study-draft.pdf (PDF stub)

Appreciate it — if you can respond by end of week we plan to publish next Wednesday.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
VP Marketing, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@novapay.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.p@novapay.com>
Date: 2026-04-13T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Approval: short security blurb for NovaPay case study

Hi Laura —

Thanks for the draft and for flagging the callout. Happy to approve a short line but made two small edits for accuracy. Please use the text below:

"NovaPay maintains SOC 2 Type II attestation and is ISO 27001 certified for its core payments services."

That wording matches our public registry and the certificates our security team put on record. We’re fine with the PDF draft as-is (feel free to include the one-liner).

Attachment: novapay-attestation-stub.pdf (PDF stub)

If you want a logo lock-up or formal permission letter, loop in Samir and I can escalate.

Best,
Elena Ruiz
Head of Product, NovaPay
elena.ruiz@novapay.com

Please use the attached stub for internal recordkeeping (we'll upload the redacted SOC 2 to the evidence repo). Once the PDF is updated with the final line, Laura can push to staging and we’ll proceed with the planned publish next week.
